title: User markers: decide what they provide beyond ObjectConnectorUser and ObjectUserBody, then add them
author: Claude-JG
description: revision2026c step RG7.5 (pythonUserItems.md 5.3), split from #2975: a user marker (position, orientation, coordinates; on a node, several nodes or a body) whose value and Jacobian are user functions. ObjectConnectorUser reaches any point of a body through its markers (GetBodyPosition, ApplyBodyForce) and ObjectUserBody defines what a local position means, so a user marker on one body adds little; what remains is a marker on several nodes or bodies (an average, a point between two bodies), which needs a marker with the coordinates of several items in the system's LTG. To be decided before it is built.
releaseNotes: New MarkerUser: a marker on any number of bodies whose position, and optionally rotation, are Python user functions of the coordinates of the nodes of these bodies, so that the built-in connectors, joints, loads and sensors act at a point of several bodies; the Jacobians by central differences if not given; test model userMarkerTest.py.
